experience: Provide an empty editor canvas and an unmistakable graphical runtime success state without adding gameplay assumptions.
expectedGraphicalRun: A neutral lit floor, origin cube, camera, and starter HUD emblem render instead of a blank white client area.
expectedNullGraphicsRun: The template owns the same preview entities as a graphical run and no HUD sprite, and the lifecycle counter advances while unpaused.
acceptance: The editor default scene remains empty.
Every runtime, graphical or headless, selects Scenes/RuntimePreview.sparkscene; only the HUD sprite is graphics-gated.
Scenes/Default.sparkscene is the editor authoring scene only and is never a runtime candidate.
Pause and resume stop and restart the lifecycle counter.
Unload removes every preview and HUD entity created by the module.
